import numpy as np
import itertools

def task_func(matrix):
    arr = np.array(matrix).ravel()
    sorted_arr = np.sort(arr)
    
    unique_combinations = list(dict.fromkeys(itertools.combinations(sorted_arr.tolist(), 2)))
    
    return sorted_arr, unique_combinations
